All rise levels are internally self-consistent and cross-confirm view1's room-label boxes exactly: ทางเดิน +0.20, เฉลียง +0.50 (=0.20+0.15+0.15), พักผ่อน +0.60 (=0.50+0.10, read as a threshold step, not a third full riser — the drawing does not label this last 0.10m explicitly as a riser, it is inferred from the two room levels' difference).
Bottom dimension chain (1.50+0.55=2.05, then +1.50 to grid B) matches the plan view and the grid master exactly — no conflicts on this sheet, unlike หน้า15's x-axis discrepancy.

A '0.45' dimension appears near the top of this section (partially cropped in this pass's close-up, visible in the full-page view above the '0.30' riser bracket) — read as a tread-depth-related dimension for the topmost step/threshold zone; not fully isolated from adjacent geometry, lower confidence than the riser heights themselves.
This confirms view1's identification of ST.1 as a short exterior entrance stair, not the main interior stair — see that file's warnings for the full reasoning.
